problem.statement: Surplus-food donors and recipients face coordination, pickup and handling frictions, while published redistribution interventions rarely establish long-term beneficiary outcomes.

sources.claim: A scoping review discusses surplus-food redistribution models and structural limitations, not demonstrated buyer demand for this particular MVP.

repository.description: A community surplus-food listing, discovery, claim and pickup prototype with published unverified feature claims.

fit.documented_capability: README claims authentication, listings, geo-discovery, atomic claiming and pickup completion.
fit.problem_requirement: Reliable donor-to-recipient posting, collection and traceability without unsafe food handling or identity/access failures.
fit.unverified_gap: No observed real adoption, business/organization onboarding, operator safety verification, food safety liability assessment or external buyer commitment. Public README mentions MIT despite no detected root license file.

market.buyer_segment: Potential food-rescue nonprofits or local institutions
